controller.heading: Who handles your data
controller.body: Meta Ads Report Studio is an independent project published by Nossair Sedki. For any question about your data, write to nossair.sedki.eng@gmail.com.

whatWeCollect.heading: What we collect
whatWeCollect.body: If you connect a Meta ad account, we keep your Meta user id, your name, the id of the ad account you authorised, and an encrypted read-only access token. Ad statistics (spend, impressions, clicks, conversions) are fetched on demand to build your report. In demo mode nothing personal is collected: the figures shown are fictional.

why.heading: Why we need it
why.body: Only to display your dashboard and generate your PDF report. We request the ads_read permission alone, which allows reading and never modifying your campaigns. Your data is not sold, not used for advertising, and not used to train any model.

retention.heading: How long we keep it
retention.body: The access token and account details are kept while your connection is active, and deleted as soon as you revoke access or request deletion. Ad statistics are not stored durably: they are fetched each time you open the dashboard and then discarded.

sharing.heading: Sharing with third parties
sharing.body: No data is passed to third parties for commercial purposes. The only technical processors are the application host and its database provider, neither of which accesses the contents of your reports.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You may at any time access your data, correct it, request its deletion, or revoke access directly from your Facebook account settings. The Data deletion page explains how.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: For anything relating to this policy: nossair.sedki.eng@gmail.com. You will get an answer within 30 days.

what.heading: What can be deleted
what.body: The data tied to your connection: your Meta user id, your name, the id of the ad account you authorised, and the encrypted access token. Ad statistics are not stored durably, so there is nothing to delete on that side.

selfServe.heading: Revoke access yourself
selfServe.body: The most direct route: in Facebook, open Settings & privacy, then Apps and websites, and remove Meta Ads Report Studio. Access is cut immediately and the token becomes unusable.

request.heading: Request deletion
request.body: To have stored data erased from our servers, send a request to nossair.sedki.eng@gmail.com:
request.step1: Include the email address or Meta user id you signed in with.
request.step2: State that this is a data deletion request.
request.step3: Deletion is carried out within 30 days, and you receive a confirmation.

demo.heading: Demo mode
demo.body: If you only used the demo, no data about you exists: that mode requires no account and no sign-in, and the figures shown are entirely fictional.

Report.title: Meta Ads Performance Report
Report.summaryIntro: The four key indicators for this ad account over the analysed period, compared with the period immediately before it.
Report.trendIntro: Amount spent day by day. The scale starts at zero so small variations are not exaggerated.
Report.breakdownIntro: Share of budget consumed by each campaign, with performance detail.

Dashboard.trendSubtitle: Amount spent day by day across the period
Dashboard.breakdownSubtitle: Share of budget consumed by each campaign
Dashboard.emptyDescription: This ad account recorded no activity between these dates. Try a wider period.
Dashboard.errorDescription: Connecting to the ad account failed. This can happen when a session has expired or the Meta API is unavailable.
Dashboard.downloadError: The report could not be generated. Please try again in a moment.
Dashboard.title: Dashboard

notConnected.title: No ad account connected
notConnected.description: Your Meta account is linked but no ad account is readable with it. Reconnect and make sure you grant access to the account you want to report on.

expired.title: Your Meta connection has expired
expired.description: Meta connections last about 60 days, and this one has run out. Reconnecting takes a few seconds and nothing else is lost.

permission.title: Missing permission
permission.description: The connection is valid but does not include permission to read ad statistics. Reconnect and accept the ads_read permission when Meta asks.

rateLimit.title: Meta is throttling requests
rateLimit.description: Too many requests have been made to this ad account in a short time. This clears on its own — try again in a few minutes.

network.title: Could not reach Meta
network.description: The request did not get through. This is usually momentary, so it is worth trying again.

server.title: Meta is not responding correctly
server.description: Meta answered with an error on their side. Nothing is wrong with your account or your data — try again shortly.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.description: The dashboard could not be loaded. If it keeps happening, get in touch and include the detail below.

notConfigured.title: Meta connection not configured
notConfigured.description: This deployment has no Meta credentials set, so no ad account can be connected. The demo works without any configuration and shows the full interface.

Dashboard.switchFailed: That account could not be selected. Try again.

hero.title: Meta Ads reports in one click
hero.subtitle: Stop losing 3 hours every Monday copy-pasting numbers into Excel. Connect your account and get a client-ready report in seconds.
hero.trustLine: Free demo · No credit card · No Meta account required

features.title: Everything your reports need
features.description: Built for agency owners and freelance media buyers who are done copy-pasting numbers into spreadsheets every week.
features.card1Description: Sign in with Facebook and securely authorize read-only access to your ad account. No setup, no configuration, no code.
features.card2Description: Spend, impressions, clicks and conversions update instantly as you switch between 7, 30 or 90-day periods.
features.card3Description: Generate a clean, professional 4-page PDF in seconds — cover page, KPIs, trend chart, and campaign breakdown.
features.card4Description: Free to try, fast to use, and fully bilingual — the interface and the PDF report both switch instantly between French and English.

cta.title: From ad account to client-ready report in under 2 minutes
cta.subtitle: Every Monday, the same chore: open Ads Manager, copy the numbers across, rebuild the layout. Meta Ads Report Studio produces the report for you, ready to send.
cta.stat1Label: saved every week per client account, on reporting you cannot bill for

howItWorks.title: Three steps, about two minutes
howItWorks.description: No setup, no spreadsheet template, no configuration file. Connect once and every report after that is a single click.
howItWorks.step1Description: Sign in with Facebook and grant read-only access. The connection can only read statistics — it can never change or spend anything.
howItWorks.step2Description: Switch between 7, 30 and 90 days. Every figure is compared with the period immediately before it, so you see direction, not just totals.
howItWorks.step3Description: A four-page PDF — cover, KPIs, spend trend and campaign breakdown — ready to send to a client without any clean-up.

signinRequired.title: Sign in to open your dashboard
signinRequired.body: That page shows your own ad account, so it needs a Meta connection. The demo needs none.

Configuration.title: The connection could not be completed
Configuration.body: Something on the server side prevented sign-in. If it keeps happening, the deployment's Meta credentials are the first thing to check.

AccessDenied.title: Access was declined
AccessDenied.body: Meta did not grant the permission to read ad statistics. Connect again and leave the ads permission enabled on the consent screen.

Verification.title: This sign-in link is no longer valid
Verification.body: It has already been used, or it expired. Start the connection again.

Default.title: Sign-in did not complete
Default.body: The connection to Meta was interrupted. Trying again usually works.
